verdict.rationale: AutoGen is a framework for building multi-agent applications, and a framework could ship a built-in data-insights feature, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows developer building blocks: AssistantAgent with LLM and tools, team orchestration, MagenticOne for file-based tasks, and the AutoGen Studio test environment. Nothing documents an in-product capability that generates insights or suggestions from the user's own data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
